sections.functional_fit: Our platform supports unlimited legal entities under a single group hierarchy. Entity-level permissions are enforced at the data layer and inherited through the hierarchy; the consolidated group view is produced from the same ledger, not a separate reporting copy. Reference architecture diagram in Appendix C. Currently deployed across a 40-entity group at a listed manufacturer.
sections.integration: Certified connectors for SAP S/4HANA (via SAP's own certified interface, ID 12-9911) and Workday (Workday Certified Integration Partner since 2022). Both are supported production connectors, documented in our public integration catalogue, with named support SLAs. Sample field mappings for both are provided in Appendix D.
sections.security: ISO 27001:2022 certified (certificate 0092-ISMS, expires March 2027) and SOC 2 Type II, report available under NDA. SAML 2.0 and OIDC SSO, SCIM 2.0 provisioning and de-provisioning. Penetration test summary from an independent firm attached.
sections.data_residency: All customer data is stored in our Frankfurt and Dublin regions. Backups remain within the same regions. Our support organisation operates from Dublin and Lisbon and does not access data from outside the EU; we can contractually commit to this.
sections.implementation: 14-week implementation with a named Implementation Manager, a Solution Architect at 0.5 FTE, and two migration engineers. Five acceptance stages with written exit criteria: discovery, data migration dry run, parallel run, cutover, hypercare. Migration approach uses our staged extract-validate-load tooling with reconciliation reports at each stage.
sections.support_model: 24x5 support with a 1-hour response commitment for P1 and 4 hours for P2, contractually backed with service credits. Named Customer Success Manager and a quarterly service review. 24x7 available as an uplift.
sections.commercial: Annual subscription of EUR 318,000 covering all modules listed in section 2 with no optional extras required for the scope described. Implementation fee EUR 96,000 fixed price. Annual uplift capped at CPI or 4%, whichever is lower, stated in our standard terms.
sections.references: Three references offered: a listed manufacturer (42 entities), a European insurance group (28 entities) and a logistics group (17 entities). Contact details on request. All are within the same size band and two are in the same sector.
